input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Hendersonville, Flat Rock, Etowah, Horse Shoe, Laurel Park, Zirconia and Saluda, NC (Henderson County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Hendersonville Flat Rock overnight summer camps 2026

candidates.name: Camp Arrowhead for Boys
candidates.note: Boys’ sleepaway camp with outdoor adventure, waterfront activities and hands-on maker projects; 2027 enrollment announced.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish coed sleepaway camp for ages 6–16, including shorter introductory sessions; 2027 programs announced.

candidates.name: Bonclarken Conference Center
candidates.note: Runs Camp Bonclarken and Music/Drama Camp for children completing grades 2–8, with day and overnight options in 2027.

candidates.name: Camp Joy
candidates.note: Residential special-needs camps at Bonclarken; four North Carolina sessions announced for summer 2027.

candidates.name: ARP Conferences
candidates.note: Quest middle-school and Horizon high-school residential conferences at Bonclarken in June 2027; youth attend with supervising church groups.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ residential camp with wilderness trips and junior, two-week and longer summer sessions; 2027 enrollment announced.

candidates.name: Camp Glen Arden
candidates.note: Girls entering grades 1–11 attend two-, three- or four-week sleepaway sessions with riding, sports and arts.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Girls’ residential adventure camp; 2026 offerings included three-week June and five-week main sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Greystone
candidates.note: Christian girls’ residential camp for grades 1–11, with four sessions of varying lengths announced for 2027.

candidates.name: Camp Highlander
candidates.note: Coed residential camp for ages 6–16; 2027 sessions range from six to 31 days, plus family weekends.

candidates.name: Camp Judaea
candidates.note: Jewish residential programs for rising grades 2–11, shorter introductory stays and one-day camp previews in summer 2027.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Runs Camp Kanuga residential sessions for rising grades 2–10, outreach Camp Bob and summer day camp; 2027 residential dates announced.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Boys ages 6–17 attend residential outdoor-adventure programs; summer 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Camp Pinewood
candidates.note: Coed residential camp with full, half-summer and first-timer sessions plus teen counselor training; 2027 dates published.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Coed sleepaway camp with two-week sessions, waterfront activities and off-campus outdoor adventures.

candidates.name: Talisman Camps
candidates.note: Residential summer adventure programs for children and teens with autism, ADHD or learning differences; 2026 handbook and catalog published.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: United Methodist camp with day programs and elementary, middle-school and high-school overnight adventures for ages 7–17.

candidates.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah
candidates.note: Girls’ residential summer camp with riding, waterfront activities, sports, arts and dance.

candidates.name: Camp Wayfarer
candidates.note: Coed residential sessions for rising kindergarten through grade 12, including introductory and teen programs; 2027 dates published.
